event_questions.label: E1
event_questions.not_this: Ordinary notice with a notice period, however short, or release from work while a notice period runs.
event_questions.question: Did the employer end the employment relationship with immediate effect, without a notice period?

questions.label: Q1
questions.not_this: An oral protest; an objection addressed to someone other than the employer; a written objection lodged only after the notice period had ended.
questions.question: Did the employee lodge a written objection to the notice with the employer (German: "beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben") no later than the end of the notice period?

questions.label: Q2
questions.not_this: 180 days counted from the notice or from the last day actually worked rather than from the end of the employment relationship; an end date that a protected period (art. 336c para. 2) or untaken leave of the other parent (art. 335c para. 3) has moved later: if the file raises either, the fact is open.
questions.question: Have more than 180 days passed since the employment relationship ended?

questions.label: Q3
questions.not_this: Talks about continuing that ended without agreement; an agreement only about a payment or about the end date.
questions.question: Did the employee and the employer agree, after the notice, that the employment relationship would continue?

questions.label: Q4
questions.not_this: Reasons the employer gave without being asked, or a request made only orally to a colleague rather than to the employer.
questions.question: Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the notice in writing?

questions.label: Q5
questions.not_this: The employee's last working day where they were released from work while the notice period was still running; the end date stated in the notice where a protected period has suspended the notice period (art. 336c para. 2) or untaken leave of the other parent has extended it (art. 335c para. 3): the period then ends later, and if the file raises either, the fact is open.
questions.question: Has the notice period (from the notice to the end of the employment relationship) already ended?

questions.label: Q6
questions.not_this: Complaints that are not claims under the employment relationship, or a mere coincidence in time with no link to the notice.
questions.question: Was the notice given because the employee had asserted, in good faith, claims arising from the employment relationship? The employee's own account of the employer's reason counts as stating it, also where the employee gives it as a conviction or belief; it is open only where the claim itself says the reason is unknown, uncertain or one of several possibilities.

questions.label: Q7
questions.not_this: Trade-union membership or union activity without an elected mandate (art. 336 para. 2 let. a, not covered here); a representative whose mandate ended through a transfer of the employment relationship, whose protection continues (art. 336 para. 3, not covered here).
questions.question: Was the employee, when notice was given, an elected employee representative on the staff council of the business or on a body linked to the business?

questions.label: Q8
questions.not_this: A resignation by the employee, a fixed-term relationship that ended by running out, or a dismissal with immediate effect (art. 337, a separate type).
questions.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q9
questions.not_this: A demand letter to the employer; a claim made pending only after the 180 days.
questions.question: Did the employee make the compensation claim pending (German: "Klage anhängig gemacht") within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship?

routing.question: Which employment-termination dispute does the claim concern? protected_period_notice: an ordinary notice of termination by the employer where the claim concerns whether it is valid or when the employment ends, because of the probation period, an incapacity through illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, or the notice period (CO arts. 335b, 335c, 336c). wrongful_termination: an ordinary notice by the employer that the claim contests as abusive (given for an improper reason, such as retaliation for claims or an employee representative's mandate), including the written objection to such a notice and the compensation claim for it (CO arts. 336-336b). immediate_dismissal: a dismissal with immediate effect, without a notice period (CO arts. 337-337c).

text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I'm still working out my notice at Rebhalde Management Ltd in Burgdorf. My notice period runs until the end of June, so I still have a few weeks to go.

I've asked myself whether this happened because I made demands, but no, it didn't. I never asked them for more money or complained about my hours, so that can't be the explanation.

On 27 April I sent Nina Vogel, the managing director, an e-mail asking her to set out the reasons for my notice in writing. I wanted to have something on paper.

Since the notice, Ms Vogel and I have not agreed that I could stay on after all. As far as she is concerned the matter is closed.

I'm still employed, so obviously my job hasn't ended yet, let alone six months ago.

The notice itself: Ms Vogel called me in on 22 April 2026 and handed me the letter terminating my employment. My colleague Nina Carter was asked to take over my clients the same afternoon.

I've attached Ms Vogel's reply to my e-mail and the first page of my employment contract.

I did not send the company any written objection to the notice. I didn't realise until a friend told me last week that this might have been possible.

I earn CHF 3,210 a month. I'd like to know where I stand and what I can still do in the weeks I have left there.

Kind regards,
Ben Odermatt
Mühleweg 7, Burgdorf
